titulo: Beyond imitation: RL, world models, and memory
lead: Imitation has a ceiling: the policy only learns what the person showed it, and it doesn't know how to recover from a mistake it has never seen. In 2026 three ideas push that ceiling: learning from its own experience (RL), predicting the future in video (World Action Models), and remembering what it has already done (memory).
objetivo: explain RL after imitation, World Action Models, and long-term memory with 2026 examples.

aprende.t: The imitate → run → fail → correct cycle
RL in post-training: Recap and RL Token
World Action Models: DreamZero, GR00T N2, Cosmos 3
Memory for tasks longer than 10 minutes

hero_alt: A robot arm placing a plate in the dish rack in a test kitchen, with a researcher watching in the background.

secoes.sub: Scroll the page: each step lights up a part.

nos.detalhe: What you did in lesson 5: the policy copies the actions in the dataset. It works, but it inherits the limits of the demonstrations.

After imitating, the policy runs, makes mistakes, and learns from the outcome and from human corrections. According to PI, Recap more than doubled throughput on hard tasks and cut failures by half or more.
The model predicts the video of what will happen along with the action. The bet is that predicting the future teaches physics better than predicting the action alone.
Remember what has already been done so you don't repeat or skip steps. PI's MEM handled tasks longer than 10 minutes, like cleaning an entire kitchen.

rolagem_fim.texto: Imitation gives the start; RL corrects with experience; the World Action Model predicts the future; memory holds long tasks together. The top models of 2026 combine more than one.

secoes.sub: Click each one. Numbers are as reported by the companies.

texto: RL with corrections and advantage-conditioned policies: the policy learns what went better and what went worse in its own attempts, and from a person's corrections.
According to PI, π*0.6 made espresso from 5:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m., folded 50 new garments, and assembled 59 boxes in a factory.
The VLA learns to emit an "RL token" that summarizes what it sees. A small actor-critic trains RL in real time on that token, with just a few hours or minutes of data.
Tested on precision tasks like tightening an M3 screw with an electric screwdriver and plugging in an ethernet cable.

A 14B World Action Model that predicts video and action together and controls in a closed loop at 7 Hz. According to the paper, it generalizes more than twice as well as state-of-the-art VLAs on new tasks and environments.
GR00T N2, announced in Mar 2026 on top of this architecture, was expected for late 2026 and had no confirmed release as of Oct 2026.
MEM gives the VLA short-term and long-term memory, evaluated on top of π0.6, on tasks longer than 10 minutes.
π0.7 (Apr 2026) accepts quality and speed metadata and subgoal images in the prompt, and learns through language "coaching" to use devices it hasn't seen. It is closed.

secoes.titulo: The imitate → run → fail → correct cycle
secoes.sub: Run the cycle. One step fails on purpose the first time: see what the correction does.
tarefas: Imitate: train the policy on 50 demonstrations
Run: 20 attempts to grab the cup
Correct: a person takes over the arm on failures (dagger)
Tune: new training with the corrections and RL

msg.inicio: 5 steps to do. Click "Run the cycle".
msg.rodando: One step at a time. The first run on the robot will hit a case the demonstrations didn't cover.
msg.parou: Stopped. The middle step stayed in rodando/. Run again to resume.
msg.retoma: Resumed: what was in rodando/ went back to the queue. What is already in feito/ is not redone.
msg.fim: Cycle complete: the second run uses what the correction taught.
msg.fimfalha: End of the cycle. "Run" went to falhou/: the upside-down cup never showed up in the demonstrations. This is the case that the correction and RL will handle.

perguntas.p: What is the main limit of pure imitation?
opcoes: The policy doesn't know how to get out of situations the demonstrations never showed.
perguntas.explica: The policy copies what it saw. A new case (the cup turned over) isn't in the data. RL and human correction address exactly that gap.

perguntas.p: What does PI's RL Token (Mar 2026) allow?
opcoes: Training the entire VLA from scratch in minutes.
Running online RL in real time with a small actor-critic on top of a token that summarizes the VLA.
perguntas.explica: The large VLA stays as it is; a small actor-critic learns on top of the RL token with just a few hours or minutes of data.

perguntas.p: What defines a World Action Model like DreamZero?
opcoes: Predicting future video and action together.
perguntas.explica: A WAM predicts the future in video and the action at the same time. DreamZero has 14B parameters and controls at 7 Hz.

perguntas.p: As of Oct 2026, what is the status of GR00T N2?
opcoes: Announced (Mar 2026), expected for late 2026, with no confirmed release.
perguntas.explica: NVIDIA showed a preview on 03/16/2026 and says it leads some rankings, but as of Oct 2026 no release has been found. An announcement is not a product.

itens.texto: RL and human correction address what the demonstrations didn't cover.
World Action Models predict video and action together: DreamZero, GR00T N2 (announced), Cosmos 3 as a base.
Memory (MEM) holds up tasks longer than 10 minutes.
